Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Karan - 32 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Meenakshi - 29 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Shalini - 65 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Meenakshi stands on the terrace. Karan and Shalini stand near her.]

Meenakshi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Meenakshi hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Karan: "Meenakshi, are you okay?"

[Karan ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Meenakshi: "That's great!"

[Karan reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Karan: "Hmm, I see."

[Karan falls from the ladder and hurts his leg.]

Karan (excited): "I'm ready!"

[Karan falls from the roof and dies.]

Shalini: "No… this cannot be!"
